title: 10″ Dopezilla Ogre Dab Rig – Black
description:
Description
The legendary Ogre is here, a clear straight tube dab rig with coloured accents on the mouthpiece, base and monster logo. It features a bent neck to make it more ergonomic to hit, hold and prevent splashback. The drum percolator will make your hit so smooth, you’ll be hungry enough to eat a human.
The 10” Ogre rig comes delivered with a male 14.5mm quartz banger. A banger is the preferred method for dabbing, making it easier and more efficient to use than typical accessories of the past.
High quality borosilicate glass.
Bent neck straight tube base.
14.5mm Female Joint.
Male 14.5mm quartz banger.
Drum percolator.
No carb hole.
